Woan Barso either does not trust his skills or does not trust his ship, and putting the lives of these children in such hands would be, I think you will agree, foolish.|attr=Denic, Malbus and Îmwe discuss the relocation of refugees|src=<ref name="GotW">[[Guardians of the Whills (novel)|''Guardians of the Whills'']]</ref>}} 
'''Woan Barso''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> who [[Smuggler|smuggled]] [[refugee]]s out of [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He transported the refugees using a [[Woan Barso's Unar-Con tug|dilapidated]] [[Spacetug|container tug]] to [[freighter]]s waiting in [[orbit]] above the moon; however, he had so little faith in his [[starship]]'s [[life support]] system that he wore an [[Color|orange]] [[Environment suit|vac-suit]] at all times.<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> Because of this, the [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Baze Malbus]] and [[Chirrut Îmwe]] did not trust him to be able to help them evacuate an orphanage.<ref name="GotW" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] passed Barso as he stood in the [[city]] shortly before the entire settlement was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

Years later, Barso became to a powerful pirate leader who would attend the summit held by [[Zeva Bliss]].<ref name="Free Fall">''[[Poe Dameron: Free Fall]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Woan Barso first appeared in the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which was released in North America on [[December 15]], [[2016]]. The character was not named in the film itself, but received identification in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''.
